entries.title: I Thessalonians 1:1
segments: ¶Paul and Silvanus and Timothy, to the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 1:2
segments: ¶We give praise to God at all times for you, keeping you in memory in our prayers;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 1:3
segments: Having ever in mind your work of faith and acts of love and the strength of your hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 1:4
segments: Being conscious, my brothers, dear to God, that you have been marked out by God's purpose;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 1:5
segments: Because our good news came to you, not in word only, but in power, and in the Holy Spirit, so that you were completely certain of it; even as you saw what our behaviour to you was like from our love to you.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 1:6
segments: ¶And you took us and the Lord as your example, after the word had come to you in much trouble, with joy in the Holy Spirit;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 1:7
segments: So that you became an example to all those who have faith in Christ in Macedonia and Achaia.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 1:8
segments: For not only was the word of the Lord sounding out from you in Macedonia and Achaia, but in every place your faith in God is made clear; so that we have no need to say anything.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 1:9
segments: For they themselves give the news of how we came among you; and how you were turned from images to God, to the worship of a true and living God,

entries.title: I Thessalonians 1:10
segments: Waiting for his Son from heaven, who came back from the dead, even Jesus, our Saviour from the wrath to come.
